get.description: This API fetches a particular number of tasks, based on the limit specified.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Additional information to include in the response

parameters.name: departmentIds
parameters.description: Departments from which the tasks need to be queried

parameters.name: viewId
parameters.description: ID of the view to apply while fetching the resources

parameters.name: assignee
parameters.description: Key that filters tickets by assignee. Values allowed are any valid assignee ID or multiple assignee IDs separated by commas.

parameters.name: dueDate
parameters.description: Due date for completing the task. Values allowed are Overdue, Tomorrow, CurrentWeek, CurrentMonth and Today. You can pass multiple values by separating them with commas.

parameters.name: isCompleted
parameters.description: Key that denotes whether the task is completed or not

parameters.name: departmentId
parameters.description: ID of the department from which the task count must be fetched

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of tasks to list

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Index number, starting from which the tasks must be listed

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Sorts tasks by the specified attribute

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Key that returns the values of mentioned fields (both pre-defined and custom) in your portal. All field types except multi-text are supported. Standard, non-editable fields are supported too. These fields include: photoURL, webUrl. Maximum of 30 fields is supported as comma separated values.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: To fetch the tasks based on the filters specified in the criteria JSON, which includes the field and its conditions.

parameters.name: filterId
parameters.description: ID of the SavedFilter to filter the records

post.description: This API creates a task in your help desk portal.

get.description: This API lists all tasks associated with a particular ticket.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Additional information related to the task. Values allowed are: contacts, assignee, tickets, teams, projects.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of tasks to list

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Index number, starting from which the tasks must be listed

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Key that sorts the tasks by a specific attribute: dueDate or createdTime. The default sorting order is ascending. A - prefix denotes a descending order of sorting.

parameters.name: isSpam
parameters.description: Key that denotes whether to fetch spam tasks or not

parameters.name: isCompleted
parameters.description: Key that denotes if the task was completed or not

parameters.name: ticketId
parameters.description: Unique ID of the ticket
